lines.trans: Hi, are you our new cook in the kitchen?
No, I am already a fired waiter from the restaurant.
Well alright, just do not get too upset about it.
Listen, maybe I really should come work with you as a cook?
And what did they fire you so quickly for today?
I accidentally served the hotel owner the wrong coffee.

words.gloss: landlady, hostess, mistress of the house

lines.trans: Well yes, that sounds just like her, good luck!
Nikita, are you still here? Eleonora asked you not to leave.
She is generously giving you one last chance today.
Congratulations on returning to work, Nikita!
It is sad that Moscow lost such an excellent street sweeper!
Change clothes quickly and head back out into the hall.

words.gloss: to go out, to get out
